references.text: Joshua mentions the same three cities of refuge east of the Jordan: Bezer, Ramoth in Gilead, and Golan in Bashan, which were designated for the eastern tribes.
Golan in Bashan is mentioned as a Levitical city and a city of refuge given to the Gershonite Levites from the half-tribe of Manasseh.
Bezer is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the Merarite Levites from the tribe of Reuben.
Ramoth in Gilead is mentioned as a city of refuge and a Levitical city given to the Merarite Levites from the tribe of Gad.
Moses gives instructions about the six cities of refuge that are to be designated, three on each side of the Jordan.
Three cities of refuge were to be east of the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan, serving as the basis for designating the cities in this verse.
Ramoth in Gilead is mentioned as an important place within Gad's territory, the same city referred to here.
Moses gives further instructions about the cities of refuge and their purpose for those who kill someone accidentally.
